description: This PHP script handles the upload and validation of image files, specifically for logos associated with quotes or company profiles in the SuiteCRM system. It verifies uploaded images, processes them, and manages cache storage, with specific size and format checks.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: Class handling the upload process, including file confirmation and moving.

classes.name: UploadStream
classes.description: Class providing directory ensuring functionality for uploads.

methods.name: confirm_upload
methods.description: Verifies if the uploaded file is valid.

methods.name: get_stored_file_name
methods.description: Returns the stored name of the uploaded file.

methods.name: final_move
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to the specified destination.
